meta.name: design-taste-frontend-v1
meta.description: The original v1 taste-skill, preserved for projects depending on its exact behavior. The current default is `design-taste-frontend` (v2 experimental), which is a substantial rewrite. Use this v1 install name only if you need exact backward compatibility.

copy.tagline_en: Preserve legacy design taste for frontend compatibility
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project depends on the exact behavior of the v1 design taste skill

howto.what: 生成前端界面代码时，按固定基线（设计变化度 8、动效强度 6、视觉密度 4）执行，用 React/Next.js 加 Tailwind，规避 emoji、Inter 字体、紫色霓虹等常见 AI 设计套路，并补全加载、空、错误等交互状态。
howto.when: 当你要做 React/Next.js 加 Tailwind 的前端界面，且需要与 v1 精确一致的行为、而非默认的 v2 时接管。

say.text: 用 React 和 Tailwind 搭一个首页，基线按 8/6/4 来
say.note: 按默认设计基线生成页面代码

say.text: 把设计变化度改成 3，界面做得对称规整些

howto.what_en: Generates frontend UI code with fixed baselines (design variance 8, motion 6, density 4) in React/Next.js + Tailwind, blocks AI design tells like emojis, Inter and purple neon, and adds loading, empty and error states.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you ask for React/Next.js + Tailwind UI work and need behavior exactly matching v1 instead of the default v2.

say_en.text: Build a homepage in React and Tailwind using the 8/6/4 baseline
